js: (async()=>{const g=__gm,T=g.T3;g.setTime(11);await g.spawnHero();g.sim(30);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,4000));const res=[];for(const id of ['elder','stroller1','merchant','receptionist','cz2','cz1']){const n=g.npcs.find(q=>q.def.id===id);if(!n||!n.inst){res.push([id,'none']);continue;}g.teleport(n.a.x+3,n.a.z+3);g.sim(3);const a=n.a;const x0=a.x,z0=a.z;a.path=[[x0+12,z0]];a.x=x0;a.z=z0;n.def._post=n.def.post;let foot=null;n.inst.obj.traverse(o=>{if(!foot&&o.isBone&&/LeftFoot$|LeftFoot$|mixamorigLeftFoot/.test(o.name))foot=o;});if(!foot){n.inst.obj.traverse(o=>{if(!foot&&o.isBone&&/Foot/i.test(o.name))foot=o;});}let prev=null,sp=[];for(let k=0;k<60;k++){a.path=[[x0+12,z0]];g.step(1,1/30);const p=foot.getWorldPosition(new T.Vector3());if(prev)sp.push(p.distanceTo(prev)*30);prev=p;}sp.sort((x,y)=>x-y);res.push([id,n.def.body,foot.name,+sp[2].toFixed(2),+sp[30].toFixed(2),+sp[57].toFixed(2)]);}return res})()
